dict.string: calla.notch imports the previous installation's settings and Shelf data into its renamed container. Original data is kept for rollback.
calla.notch discovers paired LocalSend and KDE Connect devices on your local network to send Shelf items.
The call copilot transcribes your side of a call on this Mac to suggest how to answer. Audio never leaves your Mac.

Call Copilot captures system audio. Screen Quiz captures only your selected window and sends screenshots plus selected context through local AGY to the remote model sessions you configure, with a possible arbiter and one fresh automatic retry for failed requests. Independent web research may occur. Quiz captures stay encrypted until you delete them. Quiz never clicks, types, or submits.
